name: unabridged
description: List, read and export your Claude Code and Codex sessions: just the conversation, or everything.
long_description: Reads the Claude Code (~/.claude/projects) and Codex (~/.codex/sessions) transcripts stored on this computer and exports any session as Markdown, a self-contained searchable HTML page, or JSON. By default you get just the conversation; ask for everything to include thinking, every tool call with its input and output, file diffs, subagent threads, injected context and token usage. Optional redaction masks keys, tokens, passwords, emails and your home folder. Nothing leaves your computer.

tools.name: list_sessions
tools.description: List Claude Code and Codex sessions on this computer, newest first.

tools.name: read_session
tools.description: Return a session as Markdown, paged: the conversation, or everything.

tools.name: export_session
tools.description: Write a session to Markdown, HTML or JSON files.
